To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the hydration of obsidian occurs by diffusion of ambient water into the material, (2) the hydration rate of obsidian is dependent on the ambient temperature and humidity, and (3) the hydration profile of an obsidian artifact is a function of its burial depth, burial duration, and the burial environment.
